$comment: Which of the six shapes fit a question, best first (D-100). Rules are read from the top and the first whose `when` matches gives the answer; a fact a rule leaves out can be anything; the last rule matches every question. The first shape is drawn and the visitor may switch to the others. A shape with no renderer is never offered (RENDERED_SHAPES, src/lib/resolve.ts). A rule names kinds and counts only, never a field, measure or value (tests/site/shapes.test.ts). How to add one: docs/playbooks/change-preset.md.
$facts_comment: measure: from the kind of the measure (config/measures.json): a count is a number of vehicles; a share is one part of a whole, with one figure for each value of the breakdown and the figures together making the whole; an average is a typical value of a field; a ratio is one figure set against another that is not part of such a whole (a change on a year ago, the share still registered, the combined share of the largest few, which is one figure for the group and not a share of each value). by: from the kind of the dimension (config/dimensions.json), in the data map's words; none when there is no breakdown. values: from the dimension's cardinality through value_classes. span: one_period is a window of at most defaults.trailing_window_months (config/presets.json). picked: how many values the visitor chose. crossed_with: the kind of a second field crossed with the first (a preset's cross), none when it crosses nothing.
$value_classes_comment: A dimension's own judgement of its list of values, recorded as its cardinality in config/dimensions.json: few is a short list, many is a list long enough to rank, some is in between and is not ranked. It is not a count of values and is not checked against one: a dimension marked low can have more than cardinality.few_max_values (config/data_map.json) values (one ordered band has 23), and D-050 ranks one list of about 44 values and not another of 46. Only the rules that rank read it: ranking, and the two that rank a few values chosen from the same long list (ranking_picked_count, ranking_picked_share).
$needs_breakdown_comment: Kinds of measure that mean nothing for all vehicles together: a share of the whole is always the whole.

rules.note: Two fields crossed, neither of them time, and looked at in one window: a grid with a shaded figure in each cell (D-083). Crossed over time the figures are a line for each combination, so the question falls through to the rules below.
A share by a place is a map; the same share over time is lines.
A share by an ordered band is a distribution; the same share over time is lines.
One window, a long list, and no values chosen: a ranking of every value.

The same window and the same long list, with two or more values chosen: the ranking of the values chosen, which the page labels as a ranking among those and not among every value (D-062, D-111). Offered where the ranking of every value is, so the full ranking is always one step away. One value chosen has nothing to rank, so it falls through to the lines.
As above, for a share: each share stays a share of everything counted under the conditions, not of the values chosen (docs/METRICS.md, "Ranking and ties").
Parts of a whole, over time.
Every remaining question is a line over time: a count, an average or a ratio, in total or for each value.
